checks.name: offline taxonomy
checks.sql: SELECT count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE extinct), count(DISTINCT species_code) FROM ducks.main.species

checks.name: Mallard code
checks.sql: SELECT species_code, scientific_name, taxonomy_version FROM ducks.main.species WHERE common_name='Mallard' ORDER BY species_code

checks.name: duck scope
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ducks.main.species WHERE species_code IN ('cangoo','mutswa','mallar2','egygoo')

checks.name: latest per species
checks.sql: SELECT common_name, observed_at_local, reported_count, observation_valid::INTEGER, observation_reviewed::INTEGER FROM ducks.main.recent_sightings(42.36,-71.06) ORDER BY common_name

checks.name: species endpoint
checks.sql: SELECT location_id, reported_count, observation_reviewed::INTEGER, checklist_id FROM ducks.main.recent_sightings(42.36,-71.06,species_code := 'mallar3') ORDER BY location_id

checks.name: source location
checks.sql: SELECT location_id, latitude, longitude, distance_km, location_private::INTEGER FROM ducks.main.recent_sightings(42.36,-71.06) WHERE species_code='mallar3'

checks.name: hotspots only
checks.sql: SELECT common_name FROM ducks.main.recent_sightings(42.36,-71.06, hotspots_only := true, days_back := 30, include_provisional := true) ORDER BY common_name

checks.name: empty sightings
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ducks.main.recent_sightings(-90,0)

checks.name: hotspots optional metadata
checks.sql: SELECT location_id, all_bird_species_count, latest_observation_local FROM ducks.main.nearby_hotspots(42.36,-71.06) ORDER BY location_id

checks.name: hotspot recency
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ducks.main.nearby_hotspots(42.36,-71.06,days_back := 7)

checks.name: empty hotspots
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ducks.main.nearby_hotspots(-90,0)

checks.name: sighting-hotspot join
checks.sql: SELECT s.common_name,h.location_name,h.all_bird_species_count FROM ducks.main.recent_sightings(42.36,-71.06) s JOIN ducks.main.nearby_hotspots(42.36,-71.06) h USING(location_id) ORDER BY s.common_name

checks.name: snapshot timestamp
checks.sql: SELECT (min(epoch(fetched_at)) > 0)::INTEGER FROM ducks.main.recent_sightings(42.36,-71.06)

checks.name: rounded center distance
checks.sql: SELECT distance_km FROM ducks.main.nearby_hotspots(42.364,-71.064,radius_km := 25.5) WHERE location_id='L100'

checks.name: SQL output types
checks.sql: SELECT typeof(reported_count),typeof(observed_at_local),typeof(observation_valid),typeof(fetched_at),typeof(latitude) FROM ducks.main.recent_sightings(42.36,-71.06) LIMIT 1

checks.name: season dates and year wrapping
checks.sql: SELECT season,start_date,end_date,wraps_year::INTEGER,geometry_crs FROM ducks.main.seasonal_ranges('mallar3') ORDER BY season

checks.name: range spatial intersection with hole
checks.sql: SELECT season FROM ducks.main.seasonal_ranges('mallar3') WHERE ST_Intersects(ST_GeomFromWKB(geometry_wkb),ST_Point(0.25,0.25)) ORDER BY season

checks.name: range hole excludes point
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ducks.main.seasonal_ranges('mallar3') WHERE ST_Contains(ST_GeomFromWKB(geometry_wkb),ST_Point(0.75,0.75))

checks.name: range polygon spatial join
checks.sql: SELECT r.season FROM ducks.main.seasonal_ranges('mallar3') r JOIN (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON((-1 -1,-0.5 -1,-0.5 -0.5,-1 -0.5,-1 -1))') geom) wetland ON ST_Intersects(ST_GeomFromWKB(r.geometry_wkb),wetland.geom) ORDER BY r.season

checks.name: season filter
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ducks.main.seasonal_ranges('mallar3',season := 'resident')

checks.name: weekly relative abundance
checks.sql: SELECT week_date,mean_relative_abundance,max_relative_abundance,selected_cell_count,modeled_cell_count,round(coverage_fraction,6) FROM ducks.main.weekly_abundance('mallar3','POLYGON((-1 -1,2 -1,2 2,-1 2,-1 -1))') ORDER BY week_date

checks.name: positive seasonal peak
checks.sql: SELECT week_date,mean_relative_abundance FROM ducks.main.migration_calendar('mallar3','POLYGON((-1 -1,2 -1,2 2,-1 2,-1 -1))') ORDER BY week_date

checks.name: empty geographic coverage
checks.sql: SELECT week_date,mean_relative_abundance,selected_cell_count,coverage_fraction FROM ducks.main.weekly_abundance('mallar3','POLYGON((40 40,41 40,41 41,40 41,40 40))') ORDER BY week_date

checks.name: empty peak calendar
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ducks.main.migration_calendar('mallar3','POLYGON((40 40,41 40,41 41,40 41,40 40))')

checks.name: region WKB round trip
checks.sql: SELECT DISTINCT ST_Area(ST_GeomFromWKB(region_wkb)),geometry_crs FROM ducks.main.weekly_abundance('mallar3','POLYGON((-1 -1,2 -1,2 2,-1 2,-1 -1))') ORDER BY ALL

checks.name: migration SQL schema
checks.sql: SELECT typeof(geometry_wkb),typeof(prediction_year),typeof(wraps_year) FROM ducks.main.seasonal_ranges('mallar3') LIMIT 1
